api: topologies.training.losses:get_loss('diagnostic-loss')(logits_or_prediction, targets, *, ignore_index=None, reduction='mean', report_mask, diagnostic_token_ids, diagnostic_positive_mask, diagnostic_token_mask=None, diagnostic_concept_mask=None, diagnostic_concept_weights=None, sample_weights=None, lambda_pos=0.001, lambda_neg=0.00025, tau=8.0, epsilon=1e-6)
description: Token-mean report cross-entropy plus weighted sequence-level diagnostic loss using noisy-OR for supported concepts and temperature log-sum-exp for unsupported concepts. Mean matches the paper objective; none and sum provide per-sample adapter reductions. Paper §3.2 Eqs. (4)–(10); official equations in .autopilot/sources/repo/src/diagnostic_loss/loss.py:57-146 and report CE in .autopilot/sources/repo/src/diagnostic_loss/alignment.py:65-92; structured binding contract in src/topologies/training/recipes/structured_objective.py:36-50.

examples.title: Train a sequence predictor with diagnostic loss

name: Diagnostic sequence objective

parameters.diagnostic_concept_mask: optional boolean or binary mask with shape [B, D] identifying real concepts; defaults to all concepts
parameters.diagnostic_concept_weights: optional finite nonnegative weights with shape [B, D], default one per concept
parameters.diagnostic_positive_mask: required boolean or binary mask with shape [B, D]; true marks supported concepts and false marks unsupported concepts
parameters.diagnostic_token_ids: required integer-valued vocabulary IDs with shape [B, D, K], padded per concept
parameters.diagnostic_token_mask: optional boolean or binary mask with shape [B, D, K] identifying valid IDs; defaults to all IDs
parameters.epsilon: finite value in (0, 0.5) used to stabilize probability logarithms (default 1e-6)
parameters.ignore_index: integer target label excluded from cross-entropy and diagnostic positions, or None (default None)
parameters.lambda_neg: finite nonnegative coefficient for unsupported concepts (default 0.00025)
parameters.lambda_pos: finite nonnegative coefficient for supported concepts (default 0.001)
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point aligned decoder logits with shape [B, T, V]; position t predicts targets[:, t]
parameters.reduction: mean returns global valid-token cross-entropy plus active-sample mean diagnostic loss; none returns per-sample mean CE plus per-sample diagnostic loss; sum totals those per-sample values (default mean)
parameters.report_mask: required boolean or binary mask with shape [B, T] for valid report positions
parameters.sample_weights: optional finite nonnegative weights with shape [B], default one per sample
parameters.targets: integer-valued vocabulary labels with shape [B, T]
parameters.tau: finite positive temperature for unsupported-concept log-sum-exp pooling (default 8.0)
